lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in approximately twelve visible vertical columns across the lateral flank, extending from the posterior gill region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots to form a structured grid across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is present along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from higher luminance above to shadow below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular indentation on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin; distinct white marking or scarring on the ventral tip of the lower caudal lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple remoras attached to the ventral surface; the pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of small, high-luminance spots.
